items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 181:1
items.html: The shoe of Yetzirah, which guards its lights from passing through it and downward, and likewise from the nursing of the externals, is made from the screen of Malchut in the aspect of the coarseness of a root, for what passes through it is only the aspect of NHY, lacking HGT, that is, a Nefesh lacking Ruach. See above, answer 161. (ibid.).
